scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --wait postgres && pnpm --filter @dtg/db migrate && pnpm -r --parallel dev
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

pnpm.//onlyBuiltDependencies: pnpm 10 blocks dependency lifecycle scripts by default (ADR-0005). esbuild's postinstall sets up its platform binary and is load-bearing for the build. cpu-features / ssh2 / protobufjs / msw were reviewed — native perf optionals, a CLI shim, and a best-effort service-worker copy — all safe to skip.
